description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Farseer], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast], [Double Crystarium Mode (Ice, Water)] and [Azure Arrow Follow-Up]

description.name: Awoken Farseer
description.text: Ice and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode (Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Water ability

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Azure Arrow Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Azure Arrow after using three Ice or Water abilities
